dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Here for the show? Come on in and take a seat!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Have you gone to see Ms. Yun's new opera? Ah, she truly is Liyue Harbor's superstar — there's no arguing that point!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: It's just that each time I watch her perform, I am always reminded about those things that happened in the past... *sigh*
